translations.web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
translations.bsb: “Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty? Let him who argues with God give an answer.”
translations.kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer
translations.asv: Shall he that cavilleth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.
